method: Root personally read all 228 fixed verses and adopted IDs. Chapters 18-22 were reread in full after repairs; chapters 23-25 were read in full and the final adopted-ID list and individual deltas rechecked. Mechanical source parity is separate evidence.
qualifiedLimits: God of Israel titles support a contextual people relation, never an automatic political region.
Media represents the region associated with cities of Medes; individual cities remain unresolved.
Eden near Telassar is not equated with the Genesis garden.
Berodach/Merodach variant identity is independently article-checked; Baladan remains the separate father.
Judah region/polity uses do not establish precise borders.
Moab in 23:13 is religious affiliation, not a physical scene.
The kings-of-Israel/Judah time comparison does not establish exclusive historical boundaries.
Unrepresented Chaldeans/Ammonites are not substituted with geographic or ancestral IDs.
remainingLimitations: Nisroch has no canonical ID and remains unresolved.
This does not certify all named-entity coverage, exact ancient coordinates, expert review, or profile prose quality.
Profile and Wikipedia-body reviews are separately current-SHA bound.
